: MI, cardiomyopathy, degrade of VT, PE, hypothermia, downing, electrical impulses
▪︎shockable (VF/pVT): 120–200 J biphasic or 360 J monophasic → 2 min CPR; ⍉response → epi 1 mg IV/IO + 2 min CPR (consider advanced airway/capnography)
▪︎still VF/pVT → amiodarone 300 mg IV/IO + 2 min CPR (2nd dose 150 mg); cycle CPR/epi until ROSC or POA/supervising clinician stops
▪︎ROSC → O2 sat 94–100%; treat SBP <90 or MAP <65; ⍉follows commands → hypothermia 32–36°C (89.6–96.8°F) ≥24h → improves outcomes
▪︎ROSC: ECG evidence of MI → PCI; no MI → ICU; MAP goal >65 (preferably 80–100); ⍉hypotonic fluids (⇡cerebral edema); ⍉lower glucose <100 (target 140–180)
